hash64_rule: pose_model_hash64 / pose_skeleton_hash64 are the most significant 64 bits of the engine / sidecar sha256 (CitrusPose::Prefix64), equal to the ipc_*_id_hash values Orange publishes and to /observations/pose/contract_json.metadata_cameras.<serial>.{engine_sha256,sidecar_sha256} prefixes

wrap_delta.hysteresis_test: abs(wrap_delta(raw_camera_angle - held_camera_angle)) >= minimum_heading_displacement_degrees, in camera degrees

invariants: heading_valid == 1 iff heading_status == 7; heading_camera_angle_degrees and heading_origin_camera_px are meaningful only then (payload zero otherwise)
midline_valid == 1 implies heading_valid == 1 (a midline is the projection of a valid heading)
input_used == 1 (pose) implies held_valid == 1, held_age_updates == 0, held_camera_angle_degrees == heading_camera_angle_degrees and held_* == midline_* (origin, direction, left, angle)

input_used == 2 (held) with heading_valid == 1 and midline_valid == 1 is a hysteresis hold: held_origin_canvas_px == midline_origin_canvas_px (the origin follows the fish) and abs(wrap_delta(heading_camera_angle_degrees - held_camera_angle_degrees)) < the step minimum_heading_displacement_degrees; input_used == 2 with heading_valid == 0 is a lost-pose hold with held_age_updates >= 1
input_used == 3 (fallback) iff held_valid == 0 iff fallback_id != 0; fallback_id then equals the step unknown_heading_fallback (1 static_fill, 2 uniform_side_a, 3 uniform_side_b)
pose_identity_valid == 1 implies pose_model_hash64 == prefix64(contract engine_sha256) and pose_skeleton_hash64 == prefix64(contract sidecar_sha256) for the file camera, on every row
input_used == 1 implies /observations/pose (v2) has a status-7 object row for pose_sequence_id with the same heading_angle_degrees and heading_origin_{x,y}_px
box_sequence_id_valid == 1 and pose_sequence_id_valid == 1 normally give box_sequence_id == pose_sequence_id + 1 while pose lags the box by one update

protocol_step_index equals the step active for stimulus_frame_num in /protocol_execution, and that trial-index step has features.fill.type == heading_split with features.reactive.module == PhototaxisHeadingSplit

step constants (colours, brightness, left_side, minimum_keypoint_confidence, minimum_heading_displacement_degrees, maximum_held_heading_updates, unknown_heading_fallback, fill_style) are not repeated in the row; a reader takes them from the trial-index step

phototaxis_heading_split_examples.rule: projected_left_axis_v1; arithmetic as reactive_phototaxis_v1_2026-10-13.md section 3 (binary32 probes, double homography rounded to binary32, binary32 deltas over a double sqrt, binary32 s with no fused multiply-add); pixel (i, j) is tested at its centre (i + 0.5, j + 0.5); s > 0 left, s < 0 right, s == 0 left; a pixel outside the experimental area is side_b_v1 regardless of s

pixels.note: pixel centre on the midline is assigned to the left

rows.note: forward and left_axis are binary32(0.6) and binary32(0.8); the unit normalisation reproduces them exactly under the stated arithmetic

omnifin0 parity: negative determinant (y reflection). Camera heading image-down (-90) becomes canvas up (+90); the camera left axis (1, 0) projects to canvas (1, 0). The naive canvas formula (direction_y, -direction_x) = (-1, 0) would name the fish's right.

pixels.note: camera point (25.5, 10.5), physically on the fish's left, projects to (151, 479)
s == 0 on a pixel centre under the reflected homography
outside the experimental area: side_b_v1, the side value is not consulted

rows.note: Palette's ask: nonzero h20/h21, a non-dyadic origin and an oblique heading, so that a double-precision or FMA implementation differs in the binary32 vectors. forward is binary32(cos(-37.3 deg)), binary32(-sin(-37.3 deg)); camera angle -37.29999923706055.
